calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* , cp.category, cp.subcategory FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM l) all_units, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM l WHERE category='ZZ Test') test_units,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') ctrl_units,
 (SELECT min(quantity) FROM l) minq, (SELECT max(quantity) FROM l) maxq, (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE quantity<=0) nonpos,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT subcategory) FROM l) nsub,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT subcategory FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT category)>1)) multi_cat_sub

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY cp.subcategory ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
